explanation: For one gate, decide checks over all 8 triples and all 16 blocks in F_2^4 that a solution exists with weight 1 if c = 1 + a b and 3 otherwise (the 4x4 constraint matrix is invertible over F_2). Choose such a block per gate; sum the weights with Finset.sum_ite and use card(filter p) + card(filter not p) = G.
